description_en: Strategic Location Edge of Zogu I Boulevard (Former Train Station) Security and maintenance 24/7 Central heating-cooling system etc.. Technical data: Net Area: 68.9 m² Gross Area: 87 m² Floor: 20 Orientation: West! Height 2.9 m Apartment layout: Spacious living room with cooking area; 1 bedroom; 1 toilet Advantages of the project: - 4 modern elevators; - Construction with high technical and structural standards - Flexible waterproofing PVC membrane for longevity and safety - Advanced fire protection system and certified emergency ladder - Ventilated facade and acoustic insulation for comfort and energy efficiency - Use of ecological materials and solar panels for sustainable construction - Current project status: In the construction phase, the carabiner of the -3 floor is under construction.
